title: Bug: TSA/TSB assert in test_ro_disk.py always fails for multi-asic devices
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

Currently the test checks for System Mode: ... in stdout of TSA/TSB on device, however, if performed on a multi-asic device, there are multiple lines, e.g.:
```
BGP0 : System Mode: Normal -> Maintenance
BGP1 : System Mode: Normal -> Maintenance
Please execute 'sudo config save' to preserve System mode in Maintenance after reboot or config reload
```

We need to check each line, and it should match the amount of asics (apart from supervisor, see #20577 )

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `tacacs/test_ro_disk.py` on multi-asic device until assert check after TSA/TSB fails

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test should check that `System mode: ...` appears the same amount of times as there are asics rather than it just exists

```shell

```
